breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions for the numerical method. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent, however, included both conflicting methods in its output ('Implement explicit forward Euler time integration.' and 'Apply Strang splitting...'), thereby failing to fix the inconsistency.
